splits.note: The City's bond papers list every state (Illinois EPA) loan with its rate, last year and balance, but no paper prints each loan's payment for 2026, so the line is not split into loans. That is larger than this line because it includes interest, which is budgeted on the next line.

splits.note: The City's bond papers list every state (Illinois EPA) loan with its rate, last year and balance, but no paper prints each loan's payment for 2026, so the line is not split into loans. The 2024 Sewer bond statement prints one number for state loans in 2026: $32,533,630 of principal and interest, for loans closed by mid 2024. The two Sewer loan lines in the budget add to $44,361,561, which is more, probably because loans closed after mid 2024 (the City had signed $166.5M more) are not in that table. The audited 2025 statement lists 22 loans (below).
